title: Noise-Robust Financial Numerical Entity Attribute Tagging
abstract: arXiv:2605.24910v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Financial Numerical Entity (FNE) understanding aims to recover the meaning of numerical mentions in financial reports. Existing studies focus on concept name prediction and face two important limitations. First, labels derived from inline XBRL may contain errors because filings are usually prepared manually. Second, other important FNE attributes, such as reporting-time relation, measurement scale, and accounting sign, are less emphasized. We propose NOise-Robust Tagging for Rich Financial Numerical Entity Attributes (NORA) to address these gaps. NORA uses task-aware instance-specific weighting to attenuate the influence of noisy labels during training, and we develop an evaluation protocol that filters noisy labels in real-world test sets. translated_title: 噪声鲁棒的金融数值实体属性标注
translated_abstract: 金融数值实体（FNE）理解旨在恢复财务报告中数值提及的含义。现有研究集中于概念名称预测，面临两个重要局限：首先，由于申报文件通常由人工编制，从内联XBRL派生的标签可能包含错误；其次，其他重要的金融数值实体属性，如报告期关系、计量尺度和会计符号，较少受到关注。我们提出了面向丰富金融数值实体属性的噪声鲁棒标注方法（NORA）以填补这些空白。NORA使用任务感知的实例特定加权来减弱训练过程中噪声标签的影响，并开发了在真实世界测试集中过滤噪声标签的评估协议。此外，我们构建了一个大规模基准数据集，包含630万个句子中的1140万个金融数值实体，带有多属性标签和申报元数据。实验表明NORA表现出色。
tldr: 提出NORA方法，通过任务感知的实例特定加权减轻噪声标签影响，实现金融数值实体的多属性鲁棒标注，并构建了包含1140万实体的大规模基准数据集。
en_tdlr: Proposes NORA, a noise-robust tagging approach for financial numerical entity attributes that leverages task-aware instance-specific weighting to mitigate noisy labels, accompanied by a large-scale benchmark of 11.4 million entities with multi-attribute annotations.
